Manipur Naga Village Attacked, Houses Torched in Kangpokpi District

Armed individuals attacked a Naga village in Manipur's Kangpokpi district, setting fire to nine houses. The incident involved multiple rounds of firing before the houses were torched. The violence occurred in a Naga village within the Kangpokpi district.
